title: Securing AI-Generated Code: A Just-in-Time Vulnerability Detection and Remediation Pipeline
abstract: arXiv:2608.16187v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-assisted development tools generate vulnerable code at significant rates, yet few automated mechanisms exist to detect, enrich, fix, and verify security issues at development velocity, particularly ones that ground remediation in real-world threat context. This paper presents an automated security evaluation pipeline that generates Python code from LLMSecEval prompts, scans for vulnerabilities using CodeQL and Bandit in parallel with an independent Code Validator LLM, enriches the Code Validator findings with MITRE ATT&CK techniques, CWE Observed Examples, and Python best practice guidelines, generates fixes via the Code Generation LLM, and re-scans with CodeQL and Bandit to verify outcomes. Two pipeline configurations were evaluated: Pipeline 1 (P1), using enriched Code Validator findings only, and Pipeline 2 (P2), where it additionally receives the initial CodeQL and Bandit findings. translated_title: 保障AI生成代码安全：一种即时漏洞检测与修复流水线
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16187v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：AI辅助开发工具以显著比率生成易受攻击的代码，然而，在开发速度下，几乎没有自动化机制能够检测、丰富、修复并验证安全问题，尤其是那些将修复措施基于真实世界威胁背景的机制。本文提出了一种自动化安全评估流水线，该流水线从LLMSecEval提示生成Python代码，使用CodeQL和Bandit并行扫描漏洞，同时配合独立的代码验证LLM，将代码验证器的发现与MITRE ATT&CK技术、CWE观察示例和Python最佳实践指南相结合，通过代码生成LLM生成修复方案，并再次使用CodeQL和Bandit进行重新扫描以验证结果。评估了两种流水线配置：流水线1（P1）仅使用丰富的代码验证器发现，流水线2（P2）额外接收初始CodeQL和Bandit发现。两种配置均在四个Claude模型上运行。
tldr: 本文提出了一种自动化流水线，通过结合静态扫描工具与LLM验证，利用MITRE ATT&CK和CWE等威胁上下文丰富漏洞信息，自动生成修复方案并验证，从而在开发过程中即时保障AI生成代码的安全。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an automated pipeline that combines static scanning tools with LLM validation, enriches vulnerabilities with threat context like MITRE ATT&CK and CWE, automatically generates fixes, and verifies them, thereby securing AI-generated code just-in-time during development.
